summary: The note describes how local retailers are adopting omnichannel strategies that integrate online and in-store experiences to compete with large e-commerce platforms. It covers the roles of technology providers, in-store technology, personalization, social media and supply chain optimization, with quotes from analysts and retailers. It also notes challenges such as technology investment and staff training, and concludes that physical and digital retail will keep converging.
one_line: Local retailers are using omnichannel strategies, technology partners, personalization and social commerce to blend online and in-store shopping and compete with e-commerce giants.
key_facts: Sarah Johnston, a retail analyst from Global Market Insights, spoke at a symposium on October 5, 2023, saying omnichannel is about integrating an online store seamlessly with in-store experiences.
BytePath Solutions develops user-friendly platforms that help small retailers track inventory, sales, and customer interactions across all channels.
On December 1, 2023, Mark Hamilton, CEO of BytePath Solutions, announced the launch of 'RetailSync', a suite of tools tailored for local retailers.
Hamilton said 'RetailSync' is designed to be plug-and-play so any retailer, regardless of size, can offer an omnichannel experience affordably.
In-store technologies being adopted include smart shelves, interactive kiosks, and mobile point-of-sale systems.

Jason Peters, a local retailer in Indianapolis, introduced smart kiosks in his store on November 15, 2023; customers can check availability, get recommendations, and order out-of-stock items for home delivery.

Aileen Gomez, founder of a local chain of boutiques in San Francisco, reported a 30% increase in customer retention after introducing personalized marketing campaigns through her omnichannel approach.
Daniel Richards, a social media strategist for small businesses, said on October 20, 2023 that retailers using social commerce see higher engagement rates and more online and physical store visits.
Instagram and Facebook are named as platforms that help local retailers drive both online and in-store traffic.
Oliver Thompson, a supply chain consultant, said at a conference on January 8, 2024 that synchronizing inventory across all sales channels can significantly reduce backorders.
Challenges of omnichannel adoption include investment in technology, training staff on new systems, and maintaining a consistent brand experience across channels.
